verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs state that broadcasts must first be set up in the UI and can only be *triggered* via a single API call (docs-4, docs-23), meaning full campaign creation and scheduling cannot happen entirely through the public API without touching the dashboard. Some AI/CLI/MCP tooling claims to 'create and manage automations and one-time sends' via natural language (docs-26, docs-27), but this is a separate AI-agent layer, not a documented standard REST endpoint for full broadcast creation. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint to fully author/schedule a broadcast (not just trigger a pre-built one), and independent confirmation that MCP/CLI tooling actually replaces dashboard setup for broadcasts.
